Title: Side-effect-free validation and editor-normalization split
Purpose: Make validation pure and move normalization into explicit, intentionally named entry points so correctness checks no longer mutate the thing being validated.
Deliverables: Validation helpers that are side-effect free.
Explicit normalization entry points with intentional names and clear call sites.
Tests proving validation does not mutate state and normalization is idempotent.
ReviewQuestions: Can validation now be trusted as pure analysis?
Are normalization entry points explicit and limited?
Did this split reduce hidden behavior rather than merely renaming it?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If validation still mutates state or normalization remains hidden, trigger the foundation corrective playbook and do not continue into transaction or persistence work.
